arguments.prompt: A round stone observatory chamber high in the library: a great round skylight in the vaulted ceiling letting a cool silver-gold shaft of light fall onto the floor, a big faceted stone armillary sphere and star charts on the walls, curved shelves of scrolls, a few purple crystal lamps and candles, a wide open carpeted floor with a ring pattern. Keep exactly the same painting style as the reference pictures: faceted low-poly papercraft, olive, ochre and purple colours, mottled stone, warm dusty low-key light, a dark foreground frame. Eye height low, the horizon (where the floor meets the far wall) about two thirds down the frame, and a large clear area of floor, unobstructed, in the foreground to walk on. No people, no witch, no raccoon, no animals, no text, no letters.
